macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Global stocks rebound as tariff concerns ease
items.summary: European and Asian equities rallied, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose roughly 0.5%–0.7% as investors judged the latest U.S. tariff measures less damaging than feared. The move followed a mixed U.S. session in which the Dow gained 0.3%, while the S&P 500 fell 0.3% and Nasdaq 100 declined 0.6%.[2][5]

items.title: Strong U.S. growth and inflation reinforce December Fed hike expectations
items.summary: U.S. third-quarter GDP growth was revised to a 4.3% annualized rate, while October headline PCE inflation reached 3.8% year over year and core PCE rose to 3.3%. Markets priced a near-certain 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate increase in December, while expectations for a larger half-point hike diminished.[1][3][5]

items.title: AI and semiconductor shares remain under pressure
items.summary: Nvidia fell 3.9% after S&P Global placed its credit rating on watch for a possible downgrade, citing governance concerns. Micron dropped more than 4.5%, SanDisk more than 5.5%, and AMD nearly 2% as investors reassessed the AI trade.[3][5]

items.title: ECB succession and policy outlook draw investor attention
items.summary: Markets focused on reports that Spanish central-banking veteran Pablo Hernández de Cos was likely to become the next European Central Bank president. Separately, accounts of the ECB’s October deliberations indicated that officials saw another rate increase as necessary unless the inflation outlook improved substantially.[2][7]

items.title: Bank of Japan official supports timely rate hikes
items.summary: Bank of Japan policy board member Naoki Tamura said the central bank should move policy toward a neutral level soon, strengthening the case for a possible December rate increase.[9]

items.title: Bank of England flags financial-stability risks from AI financing
items.summary: The Bank of England warned that the scale and breadth of financing supporting the AI investment boom could increase vulnerabilities in the global financial system if the sector suffers setbacks.[7]

items.title: Musk announces planned SpaceX share gift for U.S. children
items.summary: Elon Musk said every child in the United States would receive two shares in SpaceX, describing the proposed distribution as a gift valued at approximately $18 billion.[5]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin traded around $60,800, up roughly 2.6% over 24 hours after recovering from a midweek low near $57,500. Ether rose about 2.6% to approximately $1,700, while BNB, XRP, Solana and Cardano also gained.[1][3][10]

items.title: U.S. Bitcoin reserve bill advances
items.summary: A bill that would restrict the U.S. government from selling or auctioning reserve Bitcoin for 20 years advanced toward a House vote, potentially giving the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve a statutory foundation.[1][10]

items.title: Ukraine passes crypto tax and regulation framework
items.summary: Ukraine’s parliament passed legislation establishing a digital-asset framework and a 23% tax on crypto profits, expected to take effect in July 2027 and generate about $330 million.[1][2]

items.title: South Korea considers tighter stablecoin and listing rules
items.summary: South Korea’s proposed digital-asset legislation would require foreign stablecoin issuers such as Tether and Circle to establish local branches and register with regulators. The Financial Services Commission also seeks direct authority to suspend or prohibit trading in non-compliant assets.[3][4]

items.title: Switzerland launches first spot Bitcoin ETF
items.summary: Switzerland’s first physically backed spot Bitcoin ETF began trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange and gained about 0.6% during its opening hour.[1]

items.title: Fidelity files for spot Chainlink ETF
items.summary: Fidelity filed regulatory registration for a dedicated spot Chainlink investment product intended for listing on Nasdaq.[1]

items.title: LayerZero names new Zero blockchain validators
items.summary: LayerZero added Samsung Card, Kakao Pay and ZAN as genesis validators for its upcoming Zero blockchain.[5][7]

items.title: Bithumb pledges compensation after data leak
items.summary: South Korean exchange Bithumb said it would compensate affected users after the scope of a data leak widened.[2]

items.title: Zcash developers recommend Sapling deposit upgrade
items.summary: The Zcash development team recommended an upgrade that would stop new Sapling deposits while continuing to allow withdrawals.[4]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Wolfenstein 3 reportedly in production
items.summary: MachineGames is reportedly working on Wolfenstein 3, while id Software is developing another game and adding an endless Slaughter mode to DOOM: The Dark Ages.

items.title: Germany funds three women’s esports national teams
items.summary: The German government is providing €200,000 for women’s national teams in League of Legends, Valorant and EA Sports FC through a project involving the national Olympic sports body and esports organizations.

items.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered receives major patch
items.summary: CD Projekt Red released a cross-platform update adding 40 mods and addressing game-breaking bugs, lighting problems and other issues.

items.title: Terraria update adds cross-play support
items.summary: Terraria’s 1.4.6 update begins a cross-play rollout, with additional platform support planned for later stages.

items.title: Panini announces GTA VI trading cards
items.summary: Panini America is preparing real-world GTA VI trading cards for release in December through a collaboration with Rockstar Games; the initial release is not planned for Europe.

items.title: Dreadmoor launches in Early Access
items.summary: The cosmic-horror fishing survival game Dreadmoor entered Early Access after reportedly surpassing 750,000 wishlists and selling more than 100,000 copies.

items.title: Machinarium 2 announced
items.summary: Amanita Design announced Machinarium 2, marking the return of the hand-drawn adventure series 17 years after the original game.

items.title: Space Marine 2 adds new content and Weekly Clash mode
items.summary: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 received new weapons and content, including a Weekly Clash PvP mode with changing modifiers.
